body: Tested locally on Fedora 44 KDE X11 (rebased on top of `master` https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/ec67cbe92628bdaf979b10594359ba6f02cf8838), it works as expected. Code looks good to me. Some feedback: - Shared with the [Windows PR](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/119081): - `send_toast_notification()`'s `image` and `callback` parameters should be optional and default to `null` and `Callable()` respectively. - `hide_toast_notification()` should print an error when passed an invalid value (namely, a negative number, as I believe toast IDs are always positive). Alternatively, `-1` could hide all toast notifications at once. - This is printed on startup with a self-compiled editor build: ``` WARNING: Failed to register application ID: Could not register app ID: App info not found for 'org.godotengine.Godot'. at: _register_app_id (platform/linuxbsd/freedesktop_portal_desktop.cpp:728) ``` It's also printed when running the project from the editor: ``` WARNING: Failed to register application ID: Could not register app ID: App info not found for ''. at: _register_app_id (platform/linuxbsd/freedesktop_portal_desktop.cpp:728) ``` It might be worth turning this into a verbose print, at least in editor builds.
